configurations.// hub-fixtures: Runs the Hub with VITE_FIXTURES=1. With no Firebase env (no .env.local) db is null, so AuthGate signs in as a 'Fixture Director' and the director panel opens with no credentials and no real data — see src/director/hooks/fixtures.ts. Read-only: writes are no-ops.
configurations.// port: vite does not read $PORT, so it must be passed through, or vite silently sits on 5173 while the harness reports the port it assigned. strictPort makes a clash fail loudly instead of drifting again.
configurations.name: hub-fixtures

configurations.// hub-fixtures-adult: The same, built as an adult orchestra (VITE_ORG=as, features.personnel): the sample data is one paid orchestra in concert week, and the Personnel screens have a roster, contracts and a service roll to show — see src/director/hooks/fixturesAdult.ts. Opens under /as-music-hub/; Personnel is /as-music-hub/director/personnel. Read-only: writes are no-ops.
configurations.// port: Its own default port, so both fixture servers can run side by side.
configurations.name: hub-fixtures-adult

configurations.// hub-fixtures-aiso: The adult-orchestra fixtures in AISO's own look (VITE_ORG=aiso). Personnel is /director/personnel (AISO's base path is /). Edits on the Personnel screen stick in memory until a reload (personnel/fixtureWrites.ts); every other screen is read-only.
configurations.name: hub-fixtures-aiso
